changeSet.author: nexus-bbtc2
changeSet.comment: nexus-bbtc2: nexus.text_gate_probe_by_collection_384/768/1024 return (collection, chash) for the rows the text gate admits, capped per collection (a collection at the cap returns one (collection, NULL) row), in one scan of the leaf. The engine runs one for a request's lexical leg. Step 1 gathers the gated rows with a parallel-eligible plan, step 2 applies the liveness test and the per-collection cap. Posture read from text_gate_probe_<dim>: definer with search_path pinned and EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC, else invoker; EXECUTE granted to nexus_svc. No data effect: function definitions only.
changeSet.sql:
DO $do$ DECLARE definer boolean; n_def int; n_probe int; BEGIN SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.prosecdef) INTO n_probe, n_def FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'nexus'::pg_catalog.regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('text_gate_probe_384', 'text_gate_probe_768', 'text_gate_probe_1024'); IF n_probe <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'vectors-060-1: expected exactly 3 text_gate_probe functions, found %', n_probe; END IF; IF n_def NOT IN (0, 3) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'vectors-060-1: % of the 3 text_gate_probe functions are SECURITY DEFINER; the three must agree before this changeset reads the posture', n_def; END IF; definer := n_def = 3; IF definer THEN EXECUTE $f$CREATE FUNCTION nexus.text_gate_probe_by_collection_384( p_text text, p_collections text[], p_where jsonb, p_where_path text, p_cap int, p_embedding_model text, p_tenant text ) RETURNS TABLE(collection text, chash bytea) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp SET plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan SET parallel_setup_cost = 0 SET parallel_tuple_cost = 0 SET min_parallel_table_scan_size = 0 SET cpu_operator_cost = 0.25 AS $$ DECLARE v_coll text[]; v_chash bytea[]; BEGIN IF pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.lexical_trgm', true) = 'off' THEN EXECUTE $q$SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(c.collection), pg_catalog.array_agg(c.chash) FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE true AND c.embedding_model = $5 AND c.tenant_id = $6 AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY($2) AND ($3 IS NULL OR c.metadata @> $3) AND ($4 IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ $4::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', $1))$q$ INTO v_coll, v_chash USING p_text, p_collections, p_where, p_where_path, p_embedding_model, p_tenant; ELSIF pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.lexical_trgm', true) = 'substring' THEN EXECUTE $q$SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(c.collection), pg_catalog.array_agg(c.chash) FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE true AND c.embedding_model = $5 AND c.tenant_id = $6 AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY($2) AND ($3 IS NULL OR c.metadata @> $3) AND ($4 IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ $4::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', $1) OR c.chunk_text OPERATOR(pg_catalog.~~*) ('%' || pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace($1, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'), '_', E'\\_') || '%'))$q$ INTO v_coll, v_chash USING p_text, p_collections, p_where, p_where_path, p_embedding_model, p_tenant; ELSE EXECUTE $q$SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(c.collection), pg_catalog.array_agg(c.chash) FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE true AND c.embedding_model = $5 AND c.tenant_id = $6 AND c.tenant_id = NULLIF(pg_catalog.current_setting('nexus.tenant', true), '') AND c.collection = ANY($2) AND ($3 IS NULL OR c.metadata @> $3) AND ($4 IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ $4::jsonpath) AND (c.chunk_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('english', $1) OR $1 OPERATOR(nexus.<%) c.chunk_text)$q$ INTO v_coll, v_chash USING p_text, p_collections, p_where, p_where_path, p_embedding_model, p_tenant; END IF; RETURN QUERY WITH g AS ( SELECT u.coll, u.ch, pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY u.coll) AS rn FROM ROWS FROM (pg_catalog.unnest(v_coll), pg_catalog.unnest(v_chash)) AS u(coll, ch) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunk_live_owners(p_tenant, u.coll, u.ch)) ), capped AS ( SELECT g.coll, g.ch, g.rn, pg_catalog.count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g.coll) AS n FROM g WHERE g.rn <= p_cap ) SELECT x.coll, CASE WHEN x.n < p_cap THEN x.ch END FROM capped x WHERE x.n < p_cap OR x.rn = p_cap;
